items.text: Bears TE Cole Kmet suffered a non-contact knee injury, carted off, ruled out; believed serious/likely season-ending pending tests. Coach: didn't look good.
items.why: Non-contact knee buckle, carted, coach comments and sources indicate significant damage.
items.implication: TE vacuum in CHI offense; elevated snaps/routes for remaining TEs and WRs in multi-TE sets.
items.opportunity: Reduced 2/3-TE sets likely expands WR routes.

items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua left practice with calf injury, listed limited; believed minor after tests, but availability for Sunday up in the air/GTD.
items.why: Exited practice early; tests show more minor than significant.
items.implication: Monitor Friday report; if out, massive target vacuum with Adams already sidelined.
items.opportunity: If limited/out, high target share for remaining Rams pass-catchers.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson played just 21% of snaps over last three weeks.
items.why: Sustained low snap share indicates limited role despite prior hype.
items.implication: Hard to trust as flex/RB2; handcuff or deeper bench only until role expands.
items.opportunity: Low current opportunity; needs injury or scheme change.

items.text: Luther Burden only 68.8% routes but elite 2.56 YPRR; Kmet injury may reduce 2/3-TE sets, giving Burden more juice/routes.
items.why: Elite efficiency on limited routes; structural change from TE absence expands opportunity.
items.implication: ROS/WR upside boost in CHI; monitor snap/route share immediately.
items.opportunity: Higher route % and targets if fewer multi-TE looks.

items.text: Saquon Barkley is back/in-line to play Week 7 vs DAL (RB15); efficient in two full games; Dallas top fantasy RB matchup.
items.opportunity: Full workload expected vs soft run D.

items.text: Josh Jacobs allowed in facility meetings/lifting/medical (non-football); MarShawn Lloyd 49th and Kaleb Johnson 53rd in EPA/rush among qualifiers, OL mess.
items.why: Access signals readiness; poor backup EPA supports quick return to lead role long-term.
items.implication: Monitor snap ramp; positive ROS if healthy/eligible immediately.
items.opportunity: Backups inefficient creates path to early volume.

items.text: Terrance Ferguson IR recovery delayed; biggest Adams beneficiary gone. Rams answer now 25 Puka Nacua targets per game.
items.why: Ferguson delayed; Adams out 6-10 wks leaves Puka as primary.
items.implication: Elite WR1 volume if healthy; calf adds short-term risk.

items.text: Loves Jaylen Warren @ NO (RB9); more I watch, the more I love his game; Steelers have something special. Big workload friendly matchup.
items.why: Workload + matchup vs defense carved by RBs; film love.

items.text: Multiple teams open to potential trade for Colts RB Jonathan Taylor; unclear if Colts unload before deadline.
items.why: Source: multi-team interest post-Ballard firing; Taylor productive.
items.implication: Monitor for landing spot change; short-term start as usual.

items.text: Loves A.J. Brown @ CHI (WR10); Bears good yardage spot, Brown back in real role with high target share/routes.
items.why: Usage rebound (33% tgt share, 97% routes prior) + favorable matchup.
items.opportunity: High routes + target share vs soft secondary.

items.text: Loves DeVonta Smith vs DAL (WR11); elite volume expected.
Hates Josh Jacobs @ DET (RB18); workload question after long layoff.
items.why: Layoff rust + potential snap limit in return.
items.conflict: Conflicts with Levitan positive facility/backup notes.

items.text: Loves Tucker Kraft @ DET (TE6); Lions D gift to opposing pass-catchers.
items.why: Matchup vs Lions secondary/pass D allowing high production.

items.text: Week 7 Snaps & Pace: Up in pace TB @ CAR; slow slogs MIA @ NYJ, SF-ATL, IND-MIN. GB-DET and LAR-LV also up-volume.
items.why: Neutral pace/PROE data favors high-snap games for TB-CAR, GB-DET, LAR-LV.
items.implication: Prefer skill players in up-tempo spots; avoid slogs for volume.
items.opportunity: Higher combined snaps/play volume in flagged games.
